beats.label: S1 · The fall
beats.text: Bran climbs a tower and sees Queen Cersei sleeping with her twin Jaime; Jaime pushes him to hide the incest, and Bran survives crippled.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret Ned will die chasing, and the injury that eventually turns Bran into something else.

beats.label: S1 · Ned goes south
beats.text: Ned Stark accepts the role of Hand of the King and travels south to investigate the mysterious death of his predecessor, Jon Arryn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Ned inside the Lannister court and away from Winterfell.

beats.label: S1 · Catelyn takes Tyrion
beats.text: Believing the Lannisters sent an assassin after Bran, Catelyn arrests Tyrion on the road; the Lannisters retaliate by wounding Ned in the street.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First shot of the Stark–Lannister war; Ned is now injured and isolated.

beats.label: S1 · The queen's secret
beats.text: Ned discovers Joffrey and his siblings are Jaime's children, not Robert's; he confronts Cersei and warns her to flee before he tells the king.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The information that makes Ned lethal to Cersei and that seals his death.

beats.label: S1 · Robert dies, Ned falls
beats.text: When Robert dies from a hunting wound, Ned tries to install his brother Stannis as rightful heir; Baelish betrays him and Cersei crowns Joffrey.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The coup that installs a Lannister boy on the throne and jails Ned.

beats.label: S1 · Ned beheaded
beats.text: Ned falsely confesses treason to save his daughters, but Joffrey has him executed anyway; the North proclaims Robb king and marches to war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: House Stark loses its head and becomes a rebel kingdom; every later thread depends on this.

beats.label: S1 · Dragons reborn
beats.text: Across the sea Khal Drogo dies, and Daenerys walks into his funeral pyre; she emerges unburnt with three newborn dragons, the first in centuries.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's second engine ignites: a claimant with weapons no one else has.

cliffhanger.text: Ned Stark is dead and the Seven Kingdoms are fracturing. Robb marches south as King in the North, Robert's brothers Stannis and Renly stir their own claims, and across the sea Daenerys walks out of a fire holding three baby dragons.
questions: Can Robb win his war and get his sisters back from the Lannisters?
Will Daenerys turn her newborn dragons toward Westeros?
What did the deserter at Winterfell actually see in the snow beyond the Wall?

characters.name: Ned Stark
characters.line: Lord of Winterfell and Hand of the King, executed by Joffrey after uncovering the Lannister incest and being betrayed by Baelish.

characters.name: Robb Stark
characters.line: Ned's eldest son, proclaimed King in the North and marching south to war after his father's execution.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Queen Regent to her son Joffrey, secretly the mother of Jaime's children and now the true power behind the throne.

characters.name: Joffrey Baratheon
characters.line: Crowned king after Robert's death, a cruel boy who executed Ned Stark despite promising mercy.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.line: Cersei's twin and secret lover, father of her children; pushed Bran from the tower to hide the incest.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: The Lannister dwarf, arrested by Catelyn on the road and now returning to King's Landing after clearing his name.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Widowed Targaryen exile who walked into Drogo's pyre and emerged unburnt as mother of the first three dragons in centuries.

characters.name: Robert Baratheon
characters.line: King of the Seven Kingdoms and Ned's old friend, killed by a boar on a hunt he was too drunk to survive.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.line: Ned's second son, crippled after Jaime pushed him from a tower for witnessing the incest.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Ned's elder daughter, trapped in King's Landing as Joffrey's captive betrothed after her father's execution.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.line: Ned's younger daughter, fled the capital in disguise as a boy after her father's arrest.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Ned's bastard son, now sworn to the Night's Watch at the Wall as war breaks out in the south.

beats.label: S2 · Five kings rise
beats.text: With Robert dead, Stannis reveals Joffrey's bastardy and claims the throne; his brother Renly, Robb, and Balon Greyjoy each raise armies of their own.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the four-way war Tyrion and Tywin have to fight from a single city.

beats.label: S2 · Theon takes Winterfell
beats.text: Sent to negotiate with his father Balon, Theon instead sides with the Ironborn and seizes Winterfell from Bran; his own men soon betray him and torch the castle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures House Stark further; Bran and Rickon vanish and Theon becomes a hostage.

beats.label: S2 · Arya at Harrenhal
beats.text: Captured and hidden in plain sight as Tywin's own cupbearer, Arya uses a Faceless Man's debt to kill three enemies before slipping away with Gendry and Hot Pie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a Jaqen coin in her hand and sets her on the road to Braavos.

beats.label: S2 · Jon among the Wildlings
beats.text: Sent north of the Wall, Jon is captured by the Wildling Ygritte; Qhorin Halfhand forces Jon to kill him so he can infiltrate as a false defector.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places Jon inside the Wildling army as the next season's threat gathers.

beats.label: S2 · Renly killed
beats.text: Melisandre births a shadow that murders Renly in his tent; most of his forces fold into Stannis, and Brienne swears her sword to Catelyn after being blamed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Consolidates the Baratheon claim under Stannis and gives Catelyn her most important protector.

beats.label: S2 · Blackwater
beats.text: Stannis assaults King's Landing; Tyrion destroys the fleet with wildfire and Tywin arrives with the Tyrells to save the city, then quietly begins to shove Tyrion aside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Preserves the Lannister–Tyrell alliance that dominates the capital going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Robb breaks his oath
beats.text: Against Catelyn's warning, Robb secretly marries Talisa instead of the Frey daughter he was promised; north of the Wall, Sam watches an army of the dead march past.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two long fuses lit in one hour: Walder Frey's insult, and the confirmed White Walker army.

cliffhanger.text: Robb has won every battle but has just insulted the ally who controls his only bridge home. Winterfell is in ashes, Bran and Rickon are presumed dead, and north of the Wall Sam has watched an army of the dead march past a hiding rock.
questions: Can Robb repair his broken pact with Walder Frey?
What does Daenerys do now that she has a ship, wealth, and three growing dragons?
How does the Wall respond to an enemy no one there believes exists?

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Acting Hand of the King who saves King's Landing from Stannis with wildfire, only to be shoved aside the moment his father Tywin arrives.

characters.name: Robb Stark
characters.line: King in the North winning battles against the Lannisters, but has secretly married Talisa and broken his oath to the Freys.

characters.name: Stannis Baratheon
characters.line: Robert's brother and self-declared rightful king, his fleet burned at the Blackwater and his army broken outside King's Landing.

characters.name: Tywin Lannister
characters.line: Lord of Casterly Rock who arrives with the Tyrells to relieve King's Landing and reclaim the Handship for himself.

characters.name: Catelyn Stark
characters.line: Robb's mother and counsel, blamed for Renly's death, gaining Brienne's sword but losing her son's trust after his secret marriage.

characters.name: Theon Greyjoy
characters.line: Ward of the Starks turned Ironborn traitor, briefly holds Winterfell before his own men betray him and burn it.

characters.name: Balon Greyjoy
characters.line: King of the Iron Islands who rejects an alliance with Robb and sends his people to raid the North.

characters.name: Renly Baratheon
characters.line: Robert's youngest brother and rival claimant to the throne, murdered in his tent by a shadow born of Melisandre.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.line: Hiding as Tywin's cupbearer at Harrenhal, uses a Faceless Man's three deaths to escape north with Gendry and Hot Pie.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Night's Watch ranger captured beyond the Wall, forced to kill Qhorin Halfhand so he can pose as a defector to the Wildlings.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.line: Young lord of Winterfell after Robb's departure, driven from his home when Theon seizes the castle.

beats.label: S3 · Jaime loses his hand
beats.text: Jaime and Brienne, captive together, form an unlikely bond after his sword hand is cut off; he later escorts her back to King's Landing changed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reforms the Kingslayer into someone with a conscience; Brienne now has an ally at court.

beats.label: S3 · Robb loses his grip
beats.text: After executing Lord Karstark for murdering hostages, Robb loses half his army; desperate, he sends his uncle Edmure to marry a Frey daughter in his place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Forces Robb back to Walder Frey's gate with his hat in his hand.

beats.label: S3 · Dany takes the Unsullied
beats.text: In Astapor Daenerys pretends to trade a dragon for the Unsullied army, then burns the slavers and frees the city; Yunkai's army defects to her next.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives her the disciplined foot army she'll need to actually threaten Westeros.

beats.label: S3 · Jon breaks his oath
beats.text: Embedded with the Wildlings, Jon becomes Ygritte's lover but flees back to the Wall when he refuses to murder an innocent farmer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the infiltration and sends both sides charging at Castle Black.

beats.label: S3 · Sansa married off
beats.text: To thwart a Tyrell plot to steal Sansa, Tywin forces her into a marriage with Tyrion and promises Cersei to Loras; none of the four wants any of it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Chains Sansa to House Lannister and quietly ruins Tyrion's standing.

beats.label: S3 · The Red Wedding
beats.text: At Edmure's wedding feast, Walder Frey and Roose Bolton butcher Robb, his mother Catelyn, his pregnant wife, and most of his army; the northern rebellion is broken.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wipes House Stark off the war map and hands the North to the Boltons.

beats.label: S3 · Theon becomes Reek
beats.text: Held in a hidden dungeon, Theon is tortured and castrated by his captor, revealed at last as Ramsay Snow, Roose Bolton's bastard son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the man who now runs the North's most dangerous room.

cliffhanger.text: House Stark has been shattered. Robb and Catelyn are dead, Bran and Rickon are gone north, Sansa is married to a Lannister and Arya is on a road with the Hound. The Boltons rule the North for Tywin, and beyond the Wall the Wildlings are almost at Castle Black.
questions: Who is left to stand for the North against the Boltons?
Can Jon hold Castle Black against the Wildling army he just rode with?
Will Daenerys turn her freed armies toward Westeros, or stay to rule what she has taken?

characters.name: Robb Stark
characters.line: King in the North, murdered with his mother and pregnant wife at the Red Wedding after breaking his Frey marriage pact.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.line: Freed from captivity and returned to King's Landing, changed by his ordeal with Brienne and by the loss of his sword hand.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Forced by his father to marry Sansa to secure Winterfell for the Lannisters, a match neither of them wanted.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Married against her will to Tyrion to thwart a Tyrell plot, still a captive in the capital.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Broke Astapor, took the Unsullied and Yunkai, and marches on Meereen as a growing liberator across Essos.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Betrothed by her father to Loras Tyrell against her will as part of Tywin's realm-securing marriage plot.

characters.name: Theon Greyjoy
characters.line: Held in a hidden dungeon, tortured and castrated by Ramsay Snow, Roose Bolton's bastard son.

characters.name: Edmure Tully
characters.line: Robb's uncle, forced into the Frey marriage in Robb's place — the wedding that became the Red Wedding.

characters.name: Roose Bolton
characters.line: Robb's own bannerman, who conspired with Walder Frey to butcher the Starks at the Red Wedding and ended the northern rebellion.

characters.name: Walder Frey
characters.line: Lord of the Twins, whose wedding feast became the massacre of Robb's army after Robb broke his marriage promise.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Embedded with the wildlings as Ygritte's lover, fled back to the Wall after refusing to kill an innocent farmer.

beats.label: S4 · Joffrey killed
beats.text: King Joffrey is murdered with poisoned wine at his own wedding; Cersei blames Tyrion and arrests him, while Baelish spirits Sansa out of the capital.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the king, jails Tyrion, and puts Sansa in play as Littlefinger's piece.

beats.label: S4 · Tyrion's trial
beats.text: Tyrion is tried for the murder; when his lover Shae testifies against him, he furiously demands trial by combat rather than confess to a crime he did not commit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the duel that decides his life and turns him permanently against his family.

beats.label: S4 · Oberyn falls
beats.text: Prince Oberyn Martell fights the Mountain as Tyrion's champion to avenge his sister's rape; he wins the fight but is killed after gloating, sentencing Tyrion to death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Costs Tyrion his verdict and Dorne its favourite son, poisoning both alliances.

beats.label: S4 · The Wall holds
beats.text: Mance Rayder's Wildlings assault Castle Black; Ygritte dies in Jon's arms, then Stannis and a freshly funded army arrive to crush the Wildlings and take Mance prisoner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Keeps the Wall standing and repositions Stannis as the North's would-be liberator.

beats.label: S4 · Bran reaches the Raven
beats.text: Beyond the Wall Bran and his companions find the Three-Eyed Raven encased in weirwood roots; Jojen Reed dies saving them from the undead servants of the Night King.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers Bran to the person who will remake him and pauses his story inside the cave.

beats.label: S4 · Meereen and the chains
beats.text: Daenerys conquers Meereen and stays to rule rather than sail for Westeros; after her dragons burn a child, she chains two of them and Drogon flies free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delays her invasion by an entire arc and shows her losing control of her weapons.

beats.label: S4 · Kinslayer
beats.text: Jaime frees Tyrion; on his escape Tyrion strangles Shae in Tywin's bed and shoots his father with a crossbow before Varys smuggles him abroad. Arya sails for Braavos.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the Lannister patriarch and puts Tyrion on the road to Daenerys.

cliffhanger.text: Tywin is dead and Tyrion is a fugitive across the sea. Cersei's grip on her weak new son-king Tommen is shaky, Sansa is hidden away in the Vale as Littlefinger's protégée, and beyond the Wall Bran is being fed to weirwood roots.
questions: Who actually runs the Lannisters now that Tywin is gone?
Can Daenerys hold Meereen without losing sight of the throne she came for?
What is Bran becoming inside the Three-Eyed Raven's cave?

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Falsely condemned for Joffrey's murder, he strangles Shae and kills his father Tywin with a crossbow before Varys smuggles him out of Westeros.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Grieving mother of the murdered king who blames Tyrion for Joffrey's death and pushes for his execution.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.line: Kingsguard commander who frees his brother Tyrion from the black cells the night before his scheduled execution.

characters.name: Joffrey Baratheon
characters.line: Cruel boy-king poisoned to death at his own wedding feast.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Widowed by Joffrey's murder and spirited out of King's Landing by Littlefinger.

characters.name: Petyr Baelish
characters.line: Master schemer who orchestrates Joffrey's poisoning and takes Sansa away to the Vale.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.line: Abandons Westeros for Braavos to seek out the Faceless Men after leaving the Hound to die.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Defender of Castle Black against Mance Rayder's Wildlings, saved at the last moment by Stannis's arrival.

characters.name: Stannis Baratheon
characters.line: Reinvented as the North's saviour, arriving with a newly funded army to crush the Wildlings at the Wall.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Conqueror of Meereen who chooses to stay and rule, chaining two of her dragons after Drogon burns a child.

characters.name: Shae
characters.line: Tyrion's former lover whose false testimony helps condemn him, killed in Tywin's bed on Tyrion's escape.

beats.label: S5 · The Sparrows rise
beats.text: Cersei arms the fanatical Sparrows to weaken the Tyrells; they arrest Loras and Margaery for lying about his homosexuality, then turn on Cersei herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the militant faction inside the capital that ends up dictating the throne room's politics.

beats.label: S5 · Sansa wed to Ramsay
beats.text: Littlefinger delivers Sansa to Winterfell as Ramsay Bolton's bride, promising Stannis will save her; Ramsay rapes her on their wedding night while Theon watches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Sansa inside the enemy's house and turns Winterfell into the next battleground.

beats.label: S5 · Jon opens the gates
beats.text: Elected Lord Commander, Jon breaks tradition by admitting the Wildlings; at Hardhome he watches the Night King raise thousands of the fallen as new soldiers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the Night's Watch mutiny in motion and proves the dead can multiply on sight.

beats.label: S5 · Tyrion finds his queen
beats.text: Captured by the exiled Jorah, Tyrion is delivered to Meereen and becomes Daenerys's counsel; when the fighting pits reopen an ambush forces Drogon to fly her away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the show's two most important characters in the same room and then splits them.

beats.label: S5 · Stannis burns Shireen
beats.text: Down to nothing, Stannis lets Melisandre burn his daughter Shireen alive for magical favour; the Boltons crush his army, half his men desert, and Brienne executes him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Collapses the Stannis rebellion and hands the Bolton victory Sansa was waiting to be rescued from.

beats.label: S5 · Cersei's walk of shame
beats.text: Cersei confesses lesser sins to escape the Sparrows and is paraded naked through King's Landing; back at the Red Keep, Qyburn reveals her monstrous new bodyguard.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hardens Cersei into something else and gives her a champion no man can beat.

beats.label: S5 · Jon murdered
beats.text: Mutineers led by Alliser Thorne and Jon's own steward Olly stab Jon to death for admitting Wildlings past the Wall, leaving his body bleeding in the courtyard snow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the character everything at the Wall depends on, right as the dead are proven real.

cliffhanger.text: Jon lies dead in the snow. Sansa and Theon have leapt from Winterfell into unknown drifts, Daenerys has been carried off by Drogon and captured by a Dothraki horde, and Cersei walks free with a reanimated Mountain at her back.
questions: Can Melisandre bring Jon back after what she just watched happen at Stannis's camp?
Will Daenerys survive her Dothraki captors?
What can stop Cersei now that she has the Mountain reborn?

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Arms the Sparrows to strike at the Tyrells, only to be arrested and paraded naked through King's Landing herself.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Lord Commander of the Night's Watch, stabbed to death in the courtyard snow by his own men for admitting the Wildlings.

characters.name: Stannis Baratheon
characters.line: Marching on Winterfell, he burns his daughter Shireen alive for magic and is executed by Brienne after the Boltons rout his army.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Delivered to Winterfell as Ramsay Bolton's bride by Littlefinger and repeatedly raped by her new husband.

characters.name: Ramsay Bolton
characters.line: Cruel heir to Winterfell who marries Sansa and forces Theon to watch him rape her on their wedding night.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Reopens the fighting pits of Meereen and, ambushed there, is carried off to safety on Drogon's back.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Captured by the exiled Jorah, brought to Meereen, and installed as Daenerys's chief counsel.

characters.name: Melisandre
characters.line: Red priestess at Stannis's side who persuades him to burn his own daughter Shireen for the Lord of Light's favour.

beats.label: S6 · Jon returns
beats.text: Melisandre resurrects Jon; he executes his murderers, renounces the Night's Watch, and reunites with Sansa, who has fled Ramsay with Brienne's help.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Jon back on the board and joins him to Sansa for the Stark counter-attack.

beats.label: S6 · Boltons rule the North
beats.text: Ramsay murders his father Roose, his stepmother, and their newborn son to secure Winterfell, then holds their captured brother Rickon to bait Jon into open battle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Concentrates the North's evil in one person Jon has to march on.

beats.label: S6 · Bran becomes the Raven
beats.text: Bran overreaches in the weirwood visions and is marked by the Night King; the resulting attack kills the Three-Eyed Raven and Hodor, and Bran inherits the sight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Creates the character who can see the past and know what everyone else does not.

beats.label: S6 · Dany takes the Dothraki
beats.text: A captive in Vaes Dothrak, Daenerys burns the assembled Khals alive in their temple; the horde kneels, and reunited with her council she prepares to sail west at last.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives her the mounted army she needed and finally points her at Westeros.

beats.label: S6 · The Battle of the Bastards
beats.text: Ramsay lures Jon into a trap by killing Rickon before the fight begins; the Vale's cavalry saves the day, and Sansa feeds Ramsay to his own starved dogs.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores House Stark to Winterfell and clears the North of its most immediate enemy.

beats.label: S6 · Cersei destroys the Sept
beats.text: Facing trial, Cersei blows up the Sept of Baelor with wildfire, killing the High Sparrow, the Tyrells, and Kevan Lannister; Tommen leaps to his death and Cersei crowns herself queen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Wipes out every rival in the capital in one hour and makes Cersei the actual monarch.

beats.label: S6 · Dany sails, Jon crowned
beats.text: Daenerys sets sail for Westeros with the Greyjoys, the Dothraki, the Unsullied, and her three dragons; in the North, Lyanna Mormont leads the lords in proclaiming Jon their king.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two independent invasions of the same continent are now moving toward the same throne.

cliffhanger.text: Daenerys is finally sailing for Westeros with dragons and armies. Cersei sits on a throne built on the ashes of her enemies and her last surviving child, while Jon holds a united North and Bran sees history from beyond the Wall.
questions: Whose Iron Throne will Daenerys find when she arrives?
Will Jon and Sansa stand together in the North or fall to Littlefinger's whispers?
What does Bran do with the truths only he can see?

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Resurrected by Melisandre, he executes his murderers, retakes Winterfell from Ramsay, and is proclaimed King in the North.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Reunited with Jon after fleeing Ramsay, she brings the Vale's cavalry to Winterfell and feeds Ramsay to his own dogs.

characters.name: Ramsay Bolton
characters.line: Murders his father Roose to seize Winterfell, kills Rickon to bait Jon into battle, and is torn apart by his own starved hounds.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Blows up the Sept of Baelor with wildfire to destroy her enemies, then crowns herself queen after Tommen's suicide.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Burns the Dothraki Khals alive, wins their horde, and finally sets sail for Westeros with dragons, Unsullied and Greyjoy fleet.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.line: Marked by the Night King in a vision, he inherits the Three-Eyed Raven's sight after the attack that kills Hodor.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Left to govern Meereen in Daenerys's absence, he now sails west at her side as Hand of the Queen.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.line: Returns to King's Landing to find Tommen dead and Cersei on the Iron Throne, her power built on a mountain of ash.

characters.name: Rickon Stark
characters.line: Youngest Stark son, captured and killed by Ramsay to bait Jon into battle at Winterfell.

beats.label: S7 · The rivals gather
beats.text: Daenerys lands at Dragonstone with her armies and dragons; Cersei allies with Euron Greyjoy for a fleet, and Jon rides south to seek Daenerys's help against the dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Places all three sides on the map for the season's collisions.

beats.label: S7 · Cersei's opening moves
beats.text: Euron destroys Yara's fleet and captures Ellaria for Cersei to slowly poison; Jaime then sacks Highgarden, killing Olenna, who confesses she poisoned Joffrey.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Strips Daenerys of two Westerosi allies and refills Cersei's war chest.

beats.label: S7 · Dragonfire on the road
beats.text: Daenerys leads Drogon and the Dothraki against the Lannister loot train, incinerating the army; Bronn barely saves a suicidal Jaime as the war's balance tilts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real demonstration that dragons make Lannister armies useless, and starts Jaime's disillusionment.

beats.label: S7 · Jon meets Daenerys
beats.text: Jon refuses to bend the knee but mines dragonglass with Daenerys's blessing; they slowly grow close as Cersei plots behind an offered parley.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the two claimants in one room, and pulls them into an alliance that becomes something else.

beats.label: S7 · Beyond the Wall
beats.text: A raid north of the Wall to capture a wight goes bad; the Night King kills the dragon Viserion, and Jon pledges the North to Daenerys as her lover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives the enemy a dragon and welds Jon and Daenerys together as one force.

beats.label: S7 · The false truce
beats.text: Cersei publicly agrees to a truce at a wight-viewing summit but privately tells Jaime she'll let Daenerys and Jon fight the dead alone; disgusted, Jaime abandons her and rides north.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the Lannister twins for the first time and leaves the North without the promised southern reinforcements.

beats.label: S7 · Wall falls, truth rises
beats.text: Sam and Bran together realize Jon is Rhaegar Targaryen's legitimate son and the true heir to the Iron Throne, while the Night King rides the dead Viserion through the Wall.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two shattered walls at once: the ice one, and Daenerys's undisputed claim.

cliffhanger.text: The Wall has fallen. The Night King rides a dead dragon into the Seven Kingdoms, and the two Targaryen lovers marching to meet him do not yet know that Jon is the true heir and Daenerys's own nephew.
questions: Can the living stop the Night King now that he has a dragon of his own?
What happens when Jon learns who his parents really were, and Daenerys learns she is his aunt?
Will Cersei ever send the army she promised, or wait for both her rivals to die in the snow?

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Landed at Dragonstone with her armies and dragons, she takes Jon as her lover and rides north to fight the dead.

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: King in the North who bends the knee to Daenerys, unaware Sam and Bran have discovered he is the true Targaryen heir.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Feigns a truce at the wight-viewing summit but plans to let the North and Daenerys bleed each other against the dead.

characters.name: Jaime Lannister
characters.line: Barely survives Daenerys's assault on the loot train, then abandons Cersei in disgust when she breaks the truce and rides north.

characters.name: Tyrion Lannister
characters.line: Hand of the Queen who brokers the parley with Cersei and struggles as Daenerys grows more willing to burn her enemies.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.line: The new Three-Eyed Raven at Winterfell, whose visions with Sam confirm Jon is Rhaegar Targaryen's legitimate son.

characters.name: The Night King
characters.line: Kills the dragon Viserion beyond the Wall, raises him as a wight, and rides him through the Wall itself.

characters.name: Euron Greyjoy
characters.line: Cersei's new ally, whose fleet destroys Yara's ships and delivers Ellaria Sand to King's Landing.

beats.label: S8 · Alliance at Winterfell
beats.text: Daenerys and Jon arrive at Winterfell to face the dead; the Northern lords resent bending to a foreign queen, and Sam tells Jon that he is the true Targaryen heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Jon's birthright in the room just before Daenerys most needs him to have no claim.

beats.label: S8 · The Long Night
beats.text: The Army of the Dead assaults Winterfell; the defenders are nearly overrun until Arya slips past the Night King and stabs him with her Valyrian dagger, shattering him and his army at once.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the show's northern threat and reroutes every remaining player toward King's Landing.

beats.label: S8 · Missandei killed
beats.text: Sailing south, Euron ambushes Daenerys's fleet and kills the dragon Rhaegal; Cersei then beheads the captured Missandei on the walls of King's Landing in view of the queen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Strips Daenerys of another dragon and her closest friend in the same hour, and pushes her past restraint.

beats.label: S8 · Daenerys burns the city
beats.text: King's Landing surrenders, but a grief-mad Daenerys razes the city with Drogon anyway; Jaime dies in Cersei's arms as the Red Keep collapses on top of them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Daenerys from liberator to tyrant and kills the Lannister twins in the rubble of their capital.

beats.label: S8 · Jon kills Daenerys
beats.text: Convinced she will burn the whole world next, Jon stabs Daenerys in the ruined throne room; Drogon melts the Iron Throne in grief and carries her body away east.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Targaryen restoration and the throne itself in a single scene.

beats.label: S8 · A new order
beats.text: The remaining Westerosi lords crown Bran king of the Six Kingdoms with Sansa granted independence in the North; Jon is exiled to the Wall and Arya sails west into the unknown.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves every surviving Stark and settles who actually holds power at the end.

cliffhanger.text: The war is over. Bran the Broken rules the Six Kingdoms from a ruined King's Landing with Tyrion as his Hand; Sansa reigns as Queen in an independent North; Jon lives with the Wildlings beyond the Wall; and Arya has sailed off the western edge of every known map.
questions: What kind of king will Bran actually be?
Will Tyrion's elective monarchy hold once the current lords are gone?
What lies west of Westeros?

characters.name: Jon Snow
characters.line: Reveals his Targaryen parentage to Daenerys, then stabs her in the throne room and is exiled to the Wall for the murder.

characters.name: Daenerys Targaryen
characters.line: Razes King's Landing with Drogon after Cersei's surrender, then is killed by Jon in the ruined throne room.

characters.name: Bran Stark
characters.line: Crowned Bran the Broken, king of the Six Kingdoms by the assembled lords of Westeros.

characters.name: Arya Stark
characters.line: Kills the Night King with her Valyrian dagger at Winterfell, then sails west to chart the unknown.

characters.name: Sansa Stark
characters.line: Granted the independent crown of a free North after Bran is chosen king of the rest.

characters.name: Cersei Lannister
characters.line: Watches King's Landing burn from the Red Keep and dies in Jaime's arms as the walls collapse on top of them.
